criteria.text: `pdd simulate place-order --app-map app-map.json --max-calls 40 --no-open --no-wait` waits for lint that passes after 122 seconds in either an agent shell or a terminal, then creates one Try with that app map and ceiling of 40 calls, without another lint upload.
Lint, local admission, maintenance, retry backoff and Try creation share one five-minute setup allowance; passing lint does not grant another five minutes.
Pending or unknown lint creates no Try; lint that ends without a pass for the selected test remains final not run with exit 5, and a lint refusal remains exit 4.
Interruption or exhaustion of the setup allowance sends nothing further; an accepted or uncertain request is read by its original ID and is never repeated automatically.
`--no-wait` affects collection after the Try is ready and never bypasses lint; no new Try timeout flag or saved Try-lint continuation is required.

cases.given: noninteractive; place-order --app-map app-map.json --max-calls 40 --no-open --no-wait; lint passes at 122000ms; Try immediately ready
cases.required_observation: exit0 at 122000ms; one lint POST and one Try POST, no Check POST; original source/seed, app_map app-map.json and max_calls40 retained

cases.given: same command and receipts as agent-slow-lint, interactive
cases.required_observation: same result, elapsed time and dispatch counts as agent-slow-lint

cases.given: lint passes at 299000ms; Try immediately ready
cases.required_observation: exit0; one lint and one Try POST; no reset of shared300000ms deadline
exit3 at300000ms, pending wording; one lint POST, zero Try/Check POSTs

cases.given: lint passes at240000ms; confirmed not-started Try capacity reply; remaining wait exceeds60000ms
cases.required_observation: stop at300000ms; no later POST or fresh five-minute wait; no accepted Try created

cases.given: separately local slot or maintenance unavailable until300000ms before first lint POST
cases.required_observation: exit5; zero lint/Try/Check POSTs; name actual ended wait

cases.given: lint ends at122000ms; selected test has no passing verdict or refusal
cases.required_observation: exit5 immediately, final not-run reason; zero Try/Check POSTs

cases.given: lint ends at122000ms refusing selected test
cases.required_observation: exit4 with refusal reason; zero Try/Check POSTs

cases.given: separately explicit unknown lint, wrong-ID/command receipt or lost lint reply
cases.required_observation: zero Try/Check POSTs; uncertain lint reads original ID only; no new lint without confirmed safe capacity evidence

cases.given: interrupt after122000ms while lint runs, separately after lint pass before Try dispatch
cases.required_observation: no subsequent ID allocation or POST; interruption wording retains submission history

cases.given: lint passes at122000ms; Try POST reply lost; same-ID read confirms ready
cases.required_observation: one Try POST, read same ID; source/app map/cap retained
